verdict.rationale: The Needle README says the same model 'returns a vector for a sentence, so an app can search, match and route locally,' which gives on-device embeddings for search. The engine also exposes OpenAI-compatible APIs for text, and arbitrary HuggingFace models can be converted, though that path is labelled experimental. Embedding support is a single thin mention tied to the tool-calling model, so this is only partial delivery. Missing for 10: dedicated embedding model support or catalog, a documented embeddings endpoint or API, retrieval/indexing guidance, quality benchmarks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
